paragraphs: Your team does the strategic work. SolaraIMPACT gives them the data, the depth, and the speed to do it at a scale that wasn’t possible before.

Competitive landscape. Audience behavior. Industry signals. Campaign performance. The agencies that win pitches, hold retainers, and grow accounts are the ones who walk into every room already knowing more than the client expected.
SolaraIMPACT is built so that level of intelligence isn't the exception. It's the baseline.
Most AI tools know nothing about your agency. SolaraIMPACT knows everything — because you tell it once, and it remembers across every project, every client, every output.
From Monday’s pitch prep to Thursday’s strategy session to the quarterly report that’s due Friday — there’s a Solution built for exactly that moment.
Prospect research, competitive analysis, pitch narratives, RFP responses, and strategic presentations — everything your team needs to walk into a room prepared and walk out with the client.

Meeting prep, content briefs, campaign planning, PR and crisis communications, client reports — the work that fills every day, done faster and with more consistency than your team can manage manually.

Go-to-market strategy, brand positioning, audience mapping, market research, journey architecture, and budget modeling — the deep work that defines how your agency thinks and what your clients pay a premium for.
SolaraIMPACT doesn’t change how your team works — it changes what’s possible within the same day. The same people, with dramatically more to show for their time.

Your analyst used to spend half the day pulling data before the actual analysis could begin. Now the data is already there — live, sourced, and structured — and the thinking can start immediately. Every recommendation your team makes is backed by current market intelligence, not gut feel.

A pitch that took 40 hours now takes 4. A market research brief that took a week now takes a morning. That’s not just efficiency — it means your agency can say yes to more opportunities, serve clients better, and move faster than competitors who are still doing it the old way.

The platform applies your agency’s methodology, your client’s context, and industry-standard frameworks to every output — automatically. What your best strategist produces on their best day becomes the baseline for the whole team, every day.

In a 50 to 500-person agency, quality varies. Senior people produce differently from junior ones. Busy weeks produce differently from quiet ones. SolaraIMPACT closes that gap — every client gets the standard your agency is known for, regardless of who ran the brief or when.

SolaraIMPACT is built around the roles that carry the most strategic weight in a modern agency. If your work shapes clients, pitches, or the direction of the business — this platform was designed with you in mind.

You spend your days synthesizing markets, audiences, and competitive landscapes. SolaraIMPACT gives you structured research and strategic frameworks in the time it used to take just to gather the data.
You need clarity, not more input. SolaraIMPACT delivers executive-ready output — structured, sourced, and at the right level of detail to inform your decisions and client conversations.

You own the brand, the positioning, and the growth agenda. SolaraIMPACT aligns every output to your client’s audience, market context, and campaign objectives — so nothing leaves the agency half-baked.
You know what it takes to win a room. SolaraIMPACT takes the 40-hour pitch prep cycle and compresses it — without cutting corners on the depth and specificity that actually moves clients.

You hold the relationship and the standard across every account. SolaraIMPACT makes sure every client brief, report, and strategic recommendation reflects the same level of quality — regardless of who on the team runs it.
A DC-based PR agency cuts research time by 80% and multiplies client value.

Your agency will look different in three years. The clients will be different, the work will be different, the team will be different. SolaraIMPACT is built to grow with you — new solutions, new data sources, new capabilities added continuously.
15 minutes. Your brief. Your client. The real platform.

SolaraIMPACT is not a tool for one department — it is infrastructure for the entire agency.
Prospect research, pitch decks, RFP responses, call preparation. Win more with less effort.
Market analysis, SWOT, competitive benchmarking, GTM plans, audience research. Think deeper.
Multi-channel content, naming, concepts, social hooks, campaign briefs. Produce at scale.

Pick a Solution, bring your brief. 15 minutes.
Deep Thinking for AI-aware Agencies.The platform for PR, marketing and creative operations.

Every brief deserves more than a blank prompt. SolaraIMPACT is where your agency's knowledge, your client context, and the best AI available come together — and every project makes the next one sharper.

A Solution is not a prompt. It is the full workflow your senior team would run manually — except it runs in minutes, not days. Structured inputs, live data, multiple AI agents working in sequence, quality verification, and professional deliverables. 21 Solutions live today, from a roadmap of over 100.

You do not need to know which Solution to run. Describe what you are trying to achieve — for which client, for what goal, by when. Compass understands the context, picks the right Solutions, sequences the work, and builds a plan you can review before anything runs. Every conversation carries the full history of your agency, your client, and every project you have worked on together.
Understands marketing objectives, not just keywords. A complex request automatically triggers competitive analysis, audience research, and market intelligence — scoped and sequenced.
Maps your objective to the right combination of IMPACT's 21 specialized solutions, in the right order, with the right inputs.
Constructs multiple-step execution plans that you can review, adjust, and approve before a single token is spent.
Interact with completed outputs conversationally. Ask follow-up questions, request refinements, drill into specific sections, or pivot the analysis without re-running the entire workflow.
Every conversation exists within a project. Every project carries client and agency context. Nothing is lost and nothing needs re-explaining.

Two agencies. Same solution. Same client brief. Completely different outputs — because the platform already knows your methodology, your voice, and your client's full history before the first word is written.

All your company identity — positioning, specializations, methodologies, tone, and quality standards — encoded into the platform. Two agencies running the same solution on the same client receive fundamentally different outputs, because their strategic lens is different.

Complete, structured intelligence on every client — company intelligence and market position, brand architecture and messaging frameworks, audience segments and behavioral data, competitive landscape and key threats, and complete work history across all projects. Client context flows automatically into every solution execution.

An organized, dedicated workspace for each engagement, campaign, or initiative — containing full conversation and execution history, solution outputs with version tracking, team access with role-based permissions, and cross-project intelligence sharing within client accounts.

Agencies accumulate institutional knowledge over years — methodologies, case studies, pricing frameworks, compliance documentation, and team credentials. Vault captures it once and makes it available everywhere.

Upload your documents once. Vault indexes, structures, and encrypts them. When any solution executes, relevant knowledge is automatically surfaced and woven into the output — your case studies cited in proposals, your methodology reflected in strategic recommendations, your credentials presented in pitch materials. No manual copy-paste. No re-entering the same information across different workflows.
Methodologies and proprietary frameworks
Pricing structures and proposals
Company overview and positioning
Client references and testimonials
All documents remain encrypted, tenant-isolated, and under your complete control.

Marketing does not stop between campaigns. Neither does IMPACT. Sentinel continuously monitors your clients' public perception across news, social media, review platforms, industry publications, and competitive landscapes — delivering real-time intelligence without anyone asking for it.
News and broadcast media, social platform sentiment, review sites, industry publications, competitor activity, and regulatory intelligence — all tracked continuously.
Sentiment intelligence beyond positive and negative. Narrative detection, anomaly alerting, impact scoring weighted by source credibility, and continuous competitive benchmarking.
Sentinel intelligence flows directly into Compass conversations, workflow planning, and solution execution. A detected reputation shift can trigger a strategic response workflow automatically.

Every project completed, every workflow executed, every client interaction processed — IMPACT accumulates and structures this intelligence at the account level. Over time, the platform develops deep understanding of each client's market dynamics, competitive pressures, audience evolution, and strategic trajectory.
How a client's market position, sentiment, and competitive landscape have evolved over time.

Patterns and insights that emerge across different types of work — a competitive shift detected in benchmarking that informs content strategy, audience behavior changes that reshape campaign planning.
The more history the platform accumulates, the more precisely it can anticipate what a client needs next.
Your agency, your brief, your context. 15 minutes.
Deep Thinking for AI-aware Agencies.The platform for PR, marketing and creative operations.
Multiple-model orchestration. Fractal architecture. Persistent intelligence. Built from first principles for professional work that compounds over time.

Most platforms pick a model and build around its limitations. We built an orchestration layer that treats AI models as specialized instruments — each selected for what it does best, composed into workflows that no single model could execute alone.

IMPACT does not rely on training data alone. Every relevant workflow pulls from live, structured data sources — all sourced from premium providers, structured for analytical use, and cited in every output.
Real-time monitoring across news, broadcast, and digital media.
Organic and paid search landscapes, keyword intelligence, and competitive positioning.
Digital footprint analysis, audience behavior, and traffic patterns.
Census-grade demographic intelligence for audience strategy.
Sentiment, trending narratives, and community signals across social platforms.
Real-time trend detection and emerging topic identification.

Every claim, every data point, every strategic recommendation traces back to its source through a three-layer citation architecture. No black boxes. Full transparency on where every insight originates.
Live data retrieved during execution, linked to origin.
Structured data from integrated premium providers.
References from uploaded agency and client materials.

Not generic assistants. IMPACT deploys specialized AI agents configured with deep marketing domain knowledge. Each agent operates within a defined role, collaborating within workflows and passing structured context between stages.
Data gathering, source verification, and competitive scanning.
Pattern recognition, insight extraction, and strategic synthesis.
Recommendation generation, framework application, and scenario modeling.
Content generation, creative development, and deliverable formatting.
Output validation, consistency checking, and citation verification.
Workflows adapt to input complexity — a simple brief produces focused output; a detailed brief triggers deeper research, broader analysis, and richer strategic layers.
Enterprise-grade by design, not by afterthought.

The architecture was designed for capabilities that may not exist in any platform today. Persistent account intelligence that learns from every engagement. Background monitoring that detects market shifts before they surface. Cross-workflow memory that compounds institutional knowledge over time.
The foundation is already in place. The platform grows deeper with every interaction.
Deep Thinking for AI-aware Agencies.The platform for PR, marketing and creative operations.
